new_rules.text: After a success, repeat the exact same three steps again before changing anything.
After a failed try, change only the step you were least sure of.
Tell your partner only the next step, never the full order, so they can't
Try the untested step early; if the last try failed, skip the riskiest step.
After a near miss, repeat the exact step order once more before changing anything.
Exile any partner who takes the whole harvest after I advised them.
